ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels and 25% low-intensity black/dark-brown pixels concentrated primarily along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity dark band along the entire trailing edge of both lobes. High-contrast dark circular clusters are concentrated in the central-medial region of the left lobe, with more sparse, discrete dark spots scattered across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 145 degrees; vertical notch depth is approximately 5-8% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (irregular peaks and valleys) extracted along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the superior trailing edge, tapering to rounded points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of interlocking dark circular rings (rosettes) and high-contrast dark spots located on the lower-medial section of the left lobe; smaller, isolated circular dark pixel clusters present on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring patterns consistent with historical barnacle attachment; small high-intensity white calcified protrusions are visible on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'figure-eight' or interlocking dark ring pigmentation pattern located on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
